_note: Facts about the railroad that the AnyRail plan 5.3c does not hold or holds wrongly. Every output uses them. Since 5.3c (owner, 2026-11-19) the plan draws the Switch 7 crossover, Switches 13, 11 and 9 with EH-1 to EH-3, and no crossover T41/T43, all left-hand as built; the helix comes from the plan, cut at -5 cm (tools/anyrail/anyplan.py --cut -5 --stubs).

edits._note: Switch numbers, not part numbers. Switches 23, 35 and 7 are crossover or three-way halves that share one number, so a half is named as number@track once a track leaving it has a name, and before that as number@neighbour: the half a track joins to that switch (23@1, 35@23, 23@15, 35@33, 7@33, 7@13; 7@5 would answer both halves of 7). Only the relabel edit above keys by plan part number.

_milepost_origin: Switch 1 is MP 5.7 (owner, 2026-11-19): the P&OV met the P&LE at Neville interlocking, about PLE 5.7 (www/library/chartiers-valley-railroads.html). The count runs east in scale miles and carries on through the helix to the main and upper levels.
_milepost_route: The count runs the long way round the staging main: Brick-Plane, East Ext, Main East, East Lead, then the two throats into the helix (through the Switch 35 crossover to 39). Main West and West Ext, the west part of the loop, carry none.
_stations: West Yard is W-1 and W-2 with Switch 3 (owner, 2026-11-14). Brick is the interlocking between Switches 1 and 3: a control point, not a station.
_main_lines: The main flags of the `name` edit and milepost_route are written by tools/schematic/build_main_route.py from the staging rows of main_lines.csv; edit that file, not these.
_control_points: Written by tools/schematic/build_staging_sets.py from control_points_staging.csv (control_points) and stations.csv (stations, station_tracks); edit those files, not these keys.
